mapper.select: select * from discount order by discount_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into discount (discount_no, discount_name, discount_type, discount_value, discount_status) values (discount_seq.nextval, #{discountName}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, 'Y')
mapper.select: select SD.student_discount_no as studentDiscountNo, SD.student_no as studentNo, SD.discount_no as discountNo, D.discount_name as discountName, D.discount_type as discountType, D.discount_value as discountValue from student_discount SD inner join discount D on SD.discount_no = D.discount_no where SD.student_no = #{studentNo}
mapper.insert: insert into student_discount (student_discount_no, student_no, discount_no) values (student_discount_seq.nextval, #{studentNo}, #{discountNo})
